tasks.title: Implement errors, tokens, models, protocols, repository ABCs, and events
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/authentication/errors.py with the exception hierarchy rooted at AuthenticationError: InvalidCredentialsError, InvalidSessionError, InvalidResetTokenError (reason: 'unknown' | 'expired' | 'used'), PasskeyCredentialNotFoundError, InvalidPasskeyResponseError, PasskeyHijackError; all messages secret-free (error kind only)

Create src/backend/authentication/tokens.py with new_token() -> str (secrets.token_urlsafe(32): 256-bit, 43 URL-safe chars) and hash_token(token) -> str (SHA-256 hex digest); tokens are stored only as hashes

Create src/backend/authentication/models.py with the table models: Session (__tablename__='sessions', UUID primary key, indexed user_id, unique+indexed token_hash, created_at, expires_at, revoked=False), PasswordReset (__tablename__='password_resets', UUID primary key, indexed user_id, indexed email stored lowercased, unique+indexed token_hash, created_at, expires_at, used=False), WebAuthnCredential (__tablename__='webauthn_credentials', UUID primary key, indexed user_id, unique+indexed credential_id base64url, public_key base64, transports JSON-encoded list, sign_count=0, created_at)

Create the request schemas with schema-level validation (violations raise pydantic.ValidationError): LoginRequest (identifier 1..320, password 1..1024), PasswordResetRequest (email EmailStr), PasswordResetComplete (token 1..256, new_password validated with the shared user-management password rules: 8..128 chars, >= 1 letter and >= 1 digit), PasskeyRegistrationBegin (user_id UUID, username 1..320, display_name optional), PasskeyRegistrationComplete (user_id UUID, response dict[str, Any]), PasskeyLoginBegin (credential_id 1..512), PasskeyLoginComplete (credential_id 1..512, response dict[str, Any])

Create the representations: SessionInfo (user_id, created_at, expires_at), LoginResult (user: UserRead, session: SessionInfo, token: str), WebAuthnCredentialRead (credential_id, transports list[str], created_at), VerifiedCredential (credential_id, public_key, transports, sign_count), VerifiedAssertion (credential_id, sign_count); no password_hash field anywhere and no raw session token except LoginResult.token

Create the structural protocols: AttemptTracker ABC (record_failure, record_success, is_locked) and WebAuthnProvider ABC (generate_registration_options, verify_registration_response, generate_authentication_options, verify_authentication_response)

Create the repository ABCs: SessionRepository (add, get_by_token_hash, revoke, revoke_all_for_user, delete_expired), PasswordResetRepository (add, get_by_token_hash, invalidate_all_for_user, mark_used), WebAuthnCredentialRepository (add, get_by_credential_id, list_for_user, update_sign_count, delete)

Create src/backend/authentication/events.py with AuthEvent (occurred_at UTC) + LoginSucceeded (user_id, method), LoginFailed (identifier, method), Logout (user_id), PasswordResetRequested (email), PasswordResetCompleted (user_id), PasskeyRegistered (user_id, credential_id), PasskeyDeleted (user_id, credential_id); non-sensitive data only
Export the public API from src/backend/authentication/__init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
design_constraints: Field-format validation is schema-level: violations raise pydantic.ValidationError (D9, ADR-023 pattern)
Representations never expose password_hash or the raw session token except LoginResult.token (REQ-021, D11)
Events carry non-sensitive data only: no password, no raw token, no hash (D13)
The exception hierarchy is rooted at AuthenticationError with secret-free messages (REQ-019)
Tokens are 256-bit random and hashed with SHA-256 at rest (REQ-006, NFR-002)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-030, AC-034 pass

tasks.title: Implement SQLite repositories: SqliteSessionRepository, SqlitePasswordResetRepository, SqliteWebAuthnCredentialRepository
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/authentication/repository.py with SqliteSessionRepository(database_url): auto-create the DB file's parent directory, bootstrap all tables via SQLModel.metadata.create_all (shared metadata also covers the user-management tables)
Implement SqliteSessionRepository: add, get_by_token_hash, revoke (set revoked=True), revoke_all_for_user, delete_expired (delete rows with expires_at <= now, return the count)
Create SqlitePasswordResetRepository(database_url): add, get_by_token_hash, invalidate_all_for_user (set used=True on all rows for the user), mark_used
Create SqliteWebAuthnCredentialRepository(database_url): add, get_by_credential_id, list_for_user, update_sign_count, delete
Ensure each repository is safe for concurrent use from multiple threads (NFR-005): each operation opens its own session; SQLite busy-timeout serializes concurrent writers
Export the Sqlite* repositories from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
design_constraints: The ABCs are the only persistence contract the service sees; the database must be swappable later (D1, ADR-020 pattern)
Tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes (token_hash columns); no raw token column (REQ-006)
Tables are bootstrapped via create_all at repository init (no migration framework, D10)
The repositories are safe for concurrent use from multiple threads (NFR-005)
completion_gates: Integration roundtrip tests for the session, reset, and WebAuthn repositories pass

tasks.title: Implement InMemoryAttemptTracker
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/authentication/tracker.py with InMemoryAttemptTracker(max_failed_attempts: int, lockout_duration: timedelta)
Implement record_failure(identifier): increment the failure count; when the count reaches max_failed_attempts set lock_until = now + lockout_duration
Implement record_success(identifier): clear the identifier's failure count and lock state
Implement is_locked(identifier): True only while lock_until is in the future (an elapsed lock elapses automatically)
Make the tracker thread-safe with an internal lock (NFR-005)
Export InMemoryAttemptTracker from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
design_constraints: The tracker is in-memory and injectable via the AttemptTracker ABC (D5, ADR-029)
State resets on process restart (documented, acceptable for simple auth)
The tracker is thread-safe (NFR-005)
Locked identifiers are rejected even with the correct password; no lock-state signal leaks to callers (D4)

tasks.title: Implement AuthService core: login, session_info, logout
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/authentication/service.py with AuthService.__init__(user_manager, user_repository, session_repository, reset_repository, webauthn_repository, webauthn_provider=None, event_bus=None, attempt_tracker=None, session_ttl=timedelta(days=7), reset_token_ttl=timedelta(minutes=15), max_failed_attempts=5, lockout_duration=timedelta(minutes=15), rp_id='localhost', rp_name='Python Template', origin='http://localhost:3000'); a None webauthn_provider defaults to PyWebAuthnProvider(rp_id, rp_name, origin) and a None attempt_tracker defaults to InMemoryAttemptTracker(max_failed_attempts, lockout_duration)

Implement login(request: LoginRequest) -> LoginResult: look up the user by username then by email via user_repository; if the identifier is locked (attempt_tracker.is_locked) raise InvalidCredentialsError even with the correct password; for a found, active user verify via user_manager.verify_password; for an unknown identifier perform a dummy Argon2id verification against a fixed dummy hash (timing equalization, REQ-005); on failure record the failure, publish LoginFailed (method='password'), and raise InvalidCredentialsError; on success record the success, create the token (new_token + hash_token), persist a Session (created_at=now, expires_at=now+session_ttl, revoked=False), publish LoginSucceeded (method='password'), and return LoginResult(user, session, token)

Implement session_info(token) -> SessionInfo: hash the token and look up the session; unknown, revoked, or expired (expires_at <= now) raise InvalidSessionError; return SessionInfo(user_id, created_at, expires_at) without the token

Implement logout(token) -> None: look up the session by hash; if found and unrevoked revoke it server-side and publish Logout; unknown, revoked, or expired tokens are an idempotent no-op (no error, no event)
Apply @logged_class to AuthService (shared logging feature; include_args stays False; passwords and tokens never appear in log records) (REQ-022)
Export AuthService from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
design_constraints: Unknown user, wrong password, inactive user, and locked identifier all raise InvalidCredentialsError (no enumeration, no lock-state signal) (D4, ADR-028)
Every login attempt performs one Argon2id verification (dummy hash for unknown users) (REQ-005, ADR-027)
Tokens are 256-bit random, returned exactly once, and stored only as SHA-256 hashes (REQ-006)
A session is valid if and only if it is unrevoked and unexpired (INV-002)
logout is idempotent: unknown, revoked, or expired tokens are a no-op (REQ-009)
LoginSucceeded/LoginFailed are published to the injected publisher; a None publisher means no events (D12)
Passwords and tokens never appear in log records (REQ-022, NFR-002)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-001 .. AC-014, AC-031, AC-032 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-001 .. EDGE-006, EDGE-017 pass
Property tests for INV-002, INV-005 pass

tasks.title: Implement password recovery: request_password_reset, complete_password_reset
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
implementation_steps: Implement request_password_reset(request: PasswordResetRequest) -> str | None on AuthService: look up the user by email (lowercased); if found invalidate all existing reset tokens for the user (reset_repository.invalidate_all_for_user), create the token (new_token + hash_token), persist a PasswordReset (email lowercased, created_at=now, expires_at=now+reset_token_ttl, used=False), and return the raw token exactly once; if not found return None (no error, no token); publish PasswordResetRequested (email) for every request — the request always succeeds

Implement complete_password_reset(request: PasswordResetComplete) -> None: new_password is schema-validated with the shared user-management password rules (violations raise pydantic.ValidationError); hash the token and look up the reset; unknown raises InvalidResetTokenError(reason='unknown'); expired (expires_at <= now) raises InvalidResetTokenError(reason='expired'); used raises InvalidResetTokenError(reason='used')

On a valid token: mark it used, change the password via user_manager.change_password(user_id, new_password), revoke all sessions for the user (session_repository.revoke_all_for_user), and publish PasswordResetCompleted (user_id)
Update the public API export in __init__.py if needed
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
design_constraints: request_password_reset always succeeds (no user enumeration); a token is created only for registered emails (D6, ADR-030)
the raw reset token is returned exactly once to the caller (the in-process email feature); None is returned when no token is created (REQ-010 v2)
Reset tokens are single-use, expire after reset_token_ttl, and are superseded on a new request for the same email (REQ-011)
complete_password_reset changes the password via user-management (shared rules) and revokes all sessions for the user (REQ-012, ADR-027)
Invalid tokens raise InvalidResetTokenError with reason 'unknown' | 'expired' | 'used' (REQ-013)
PasswordResetRequested/PasswordResetCompleted are published to the injected publisher; a None publisher means no events (D12)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-015 .. AC-021 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-007 .. EDGE-012 pass

tasks.title: Implement Passkey/WebAuthn: PyWebAuthnProvider, registration, login, list, delete
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/authentication/webauthn.py with PyWebAuthnProvider(rp_id, rp_name, origin) implementing WebAuthnProvider: wrap py-webauthn's generate_registration_options, verify_registration_response, generate_authentication_options, and verify_authentication_response; raise InvalidPasskeyResponseError when the underlying verification fails; map verified results to VerifiedCredential/VerifiedAssertion
Implement begin_passkey_registration(request) -> dict[str, Any] on AuthService: return the provider's registration options

Implement complete_passkey_registration(request) -> WebAuthnCredentialRead: verify the response via the provider (failure raises InvalidPasskeyResponseError and nothing is stored), persist a WebAuthnCredential (user_id, credential_id, public_key, transports, sign_count), publish PasskeyRegistered, and return WebAuthnCredentialRead
Implement begin_passkey_login(request) -> dict[str, Any]: look up the credential by credential_id (unknown raises PasskeyCredentialNotFoundError) and return the provider's authentication options

Implement complete_passkey_login(request) -> LoginResult: verify the assertion via the provider (failure raises InvalidPasskeyResponseError and no session is issued); look up the stored credential; reject a response sign count lower than the stored sign count with PasskeyHijackError (no session); update the stored sign count; issue the session (token, Session, LoginResult, method='passkey'); publish LoginSucceeded

Implement list_passkeys(user_id) -> list[WebAuthnCredentialRead] and delete_passkey(user_id, credential_id) -> None: deleting an unknown or foreign credential raises PasskeyCredentialNotFoundError; a successful delete publishes PasskeyDeleted
Export PyWebAuthnProvider from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/authentication/ tests/property/authentication/ tests/unit/authentication/ tests/contract/authentication/ tests/integration/authentication/ -v
design_constraints: The service references only the WebAuthnProvider ABC; the WebAuthn backend must be swappable (D7, ADR-031)
A sign-count regression is rejected with PasskeyHijackError and no session is issued (REQ-016)
A failed WebAuthn response raises InvalidPasskeyResponseError; nothing is stored or issued (EDGE-013, EDGE-016)
begin_passkey_login raises PasskeyCredentialNotFoundError for unregistered credential ids (EDGE-014)
Password and passkey coexist: neither method disables the other (REQ-018)
PasskeyRegistered/PasskeyDeleted are published to the injected publisher; a None publisher means no events (D12)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-022 .. AC-029 pass
Edge tests for EDGE-013 .. EDGE-016 pass
